thesis: Neither side carried the debate decisively. SoFi has unusually strong reported growth and a credible profitability trajectory, but valuation, negative free cash flow, weak price momentum, and missing credit-quality evidence prevent a reliable directional conclusion from the completed-close snapshot.
strongest_counterexample: If the Q2 growth rate and raised FY2026 guide are accompanied by stable credit losses, improving cash conversion, and a technical reclaim of EMA-20, the current selloff could be a valuation reset rather than a broken thesis.
invalidation_conditions: Next reported quarter shows adjusted net-revenue growth below 25% or management withdraws the FY2026 $4.75B-$4.85B adjusted net-revenue guide
Credit-loss or delinquency metrics materially worsen while price remains below the recent $17.37 support area
A sustained close above EMA-20 near $18.08 with volume materially above the stored average would invalidate the immediate downside-momentum case
evidence_gaps: No usable dated Layer 1 news headlines
No credit-loss, delinquency, deposit, funding-cost, or loan-growth trend in Layer 1
Gross and operating margins are null
No finite RSI-14, SMA-20/50/200, Bollinger Bands, or ATR-14 because of the 2026-08-28 non-finite OHLC bar
decisive_factors: Official Q2 reported record revenue, member/product growth, and raised guidance
36.4082x trailing P/E and negative $3.994B free cash flow
Price below EMA-20 with negative MACD histogram and 0.1788x volume ratio
Mixed recommendation distribution and missing credit-quality evidence
